blocks.text: Leviticus 22 contains 33 verses. It opens with: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying, It concludes with: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Leviticus moves from sacrifice and priestly inauguration through purity and the Day of Atonement into instructions for holy communal life, sacred time, land, covenant consequences, and vows.
